summary: Four listed churches in one family bulletin: Annunciation, Immaculate Conception, St. Vincent de Paul and the Memorare Chapel. There is no schedule box; weekly times come from the Mass calendar and the Adoration and Confession lists on page 2, repeated in all five bulletins read. Open: the First Friday overnight Adoration at Annunciation.
